title.rendered: Mobilunity Is a Top Company to Watch in 2018 – European Business Awards®

content.rendered:
Kyiv, Ukraine – 20 December, 2017 – Mobilunity, a Ukrainian-based, global provider of dedicated development teams, has been selected as one of just over 20 companies that will appear on the 2018 European Business Awards® – “Ones to Watch List for Ukraine”. The National Winners Awards will be held on March 2018 in Kyiv.

Thanks to the Company’s rapid development throughout 2017, Mobilunity was nominated by the European Business Awards® as one of the most successful companies in the region. Within a 12 month period, Mobilunity has delivered dedicated development teams in Ukraine, for its various clients across the globe in countries such as Switzerland, Israel, Germany, France, Denmark, Luxembourg, Canada, USA and Hong Kong.

Since 2007, the European Business Awards® regularly award companies, which show outstanding results across diverse industries. As one of the most prestigious achievements a company can receive, the Awards are meant to honor those that focus on promoting innovation,  driving success, and fostering an ethical environment within the European business community. For this reason, it is considered one of the world’s most influential cross-industry business competitions.

During the year Mobilunity continued its outreach within the European community by attending various events with its top level executives including Adtech Israel and Swiss Startup Days, as well as doing its part to shed new light on what Ukraine has to offer the rest of Europe by hosting clients and potential clients alike to its offices in the heart of Kyiv.

According to the Mobilunity CEO, Cyril Samovskiy: “It’s an honor for both myself and the Mobilunity family to be considered for such a prestigious nomination. It’s been a goal of ours to represent the very best in Ukrainian development, and this consideration shows that we are definitely heading in the right direction with our clients, our community, and our processes.”
